posts.author: DrasticDaniel
posts.body: Hello! I've been poking around with different rpg maker versions for the past 6 months now. I've decided to work more closely with MV and MZ, though I really want to learn a lot more of 2k/2k3. I LOVE the classic Jrpg's like dragon quest, earthbound, and final fantasy. Each have inspired me to make my own game using this engine. I started as an artist and I'm beginning to learn pixel art. I also compose music sometimes. I'm here because I want to get to know more about the community (and maybe find people I wanna work with in the future).
